title: vl06: Postulat 5 without the Hermiticity of H (added in the text) and without self-adjointness for unbounded H

legacy.old_text: Im Postulat fehlt eine Voraussetzung, die wir hier nachtragen: Der Hamiltonoperator $H$ ist stets \emph{hermitesch}.

reason: Hazard H4.3: for unbounded H, symmetric (Hermitian) is not enough for U_t to be unitary; self-adjointness is required (Stone's theorem, c04.thm.stone). The Kern (finite dimension) keeps 'hermitesch' inside the rule; Vertiefung c04.v2 states the general condition.

evidence.independent_check: read in the script sources at the stated lines (git show 90fe735d:latex/lectures/de/vl05.tex, vl06.tex)
